description: This file defines server route handlers for browser automation tasks such as navigation, screenshot, PDF generation, and snapshotting, specifically for Chrome MCP and Playwright integrations.

methods.name: clearChromeMcpOverlay
methods.description: Removes overlay elements from the Chrome MCP page.

methods.name: renderChromeMcpLabels
methods.description: Adds label overlays to specified DOM elements in Chrome MCP.

methods.name: saveNormalizedScreenshotResponse
methods.description: Normalizes and saves a screenshot buffer, then responds with its path.

methods.name: saveBrowserMediaResponse
methods.description: Saves media buffer and responds with its path and metadata.

methods.name: resolveTargetIdAfterNavigate
methods.description: Determines the correct targetId after navigation, handling potential renderer swaps.

methods.name: registerBrowserAgentSnapshotRoutes
methods.description: Registers HTTP route handlers for navigation, screenshot, PDF, and snapshot endpoints.
